data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The asymmetry between compile.py (1/9 lost) and the ordinarily-guarded modules (4/4 to 6/7) is not a property of the tests but of the guard installation order: compile.py was installed after the mutation, the others before.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If compile.py mutations are drawn from the same distribution as module mutations","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the installation order is randomized across the repository","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 1/9 result replicates in a second independent week","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the ordinarily-guarded modules show the same loss rate when installed after","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"When a guard is installed before its mutation, the mutation must be crafted to evade the guard, which forces the mutation to be non-trivial and therefore more detectable.
